rubric.role_summary: Onsite quality assurance management role at a fluid dairy processing plant, overseeing food safety and quality programs, SQF implementation, laboratory operations, and a team of seven QA technicians.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Onsite quality assurance management role at a fluid dairy processing plant, overseeing food safety and quality programs, SQF implementation, laboratory operations, and a team of seven QA technicians.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Demonstrated success leading and managing people in a team environment.
- Demonstrated responsibility for food safety and quality.
- Knowledge of food microbiology, food chemistry, or dairy standards.
- Working knowledge of HACCP and GFSI-compliant programs.
- BS in Food Science, Microbiology, or a related field AND 3 or more years of quality assurance experience in a food processing environment; OR an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the job's essential duties.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Knowledge of food microbiology, chemistry, dairy standards, and CIP sanitation.
- Strong computer skills with Microsoft Office suite, Google suite, and ERP.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Petaluma, CA, United States area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
